text:
kevin: Created RC rc-2026-03-12_1 and pushed artifacts (sha: abcdef12). Proposal: pin for 2026-03-13T18:00Z UTC. Canary plan: 5% -> 25% -> 100%. Requesting ops + oncall + sheriff ack.

deploy-bot: [bot] RC record created: rc-2026-03-12_1. To schedule promotion: `/deploy promote rc-2026-03-12_1 --schedule 2026-03-13T18:00Z --traffic 5,25,100 --steps 20m,20m`

ash: Ack. Please add a short release-note blurb, list of affected routes, and explicit rollback command. Also add KV warm steps.

kevin: Release notes (short):
```
- routing: graceful fallback to small-model on OOM to reduce tail latency
- serving: optimize KV cache warm path for prompt-prefix reuse
- observability: per-route token cost breakdown and alerting
```

maria: I'll be oncall for the 18:00-20:00 UTC window. Will watch latency dashboards, token-cost graphs, and error-rate. Add me to sheriff rotation.

sheriff-jen: I'll take sheriff for the first 30m. Abort criteria: >5% global error-rate above baseline OR 2x p95 latency for >10m. On those triggers we rollback.

devops: Artifact pin: `sha: abcdef12`. Canary config ready. Sample promote/rollback commands below. Make sure the DB migration flag is NOT set for this release (no schema changes).
```
# promote (example)
deploy-bot promote rc-2026-03-12_1 --window 2026-03-13T18:00Z --canary 5% --canary-duration 20m --next 25% --next-duration 20m

# immediate rollback (example)
deploy-bot rollback rc-2026-03-12_1 --to rc-2026-03-11_4 --reason "latency spike / SLO breach"
```

qa-sam: Staging smoke + perf tests: all green. Added perf regression check for token-latency. Test artifacts: staging-smoke/2026-03-12-1.log (link pasted in the console).

kevin: KV warm playbook (short):
```
curl -X POST https://warm.redwood.internal/warm -d '{"rc":"rc-2026-03-12_1","paths":["/v1/chat","/v1/generate"],"concurrency":20}'
# run from CI worker 3 times prior to promo start, wait 2m between runs
```

ash: Approved. ops, oncall, QA, and sheriff acked. kevin — please pin the release notes to the changelog and schedule the promote.

kevin: Scheduling promote now. Running the promote command in 60s. Leaving a note in deploy history.

deploy-bot: Promotion scheduled at 2026-03-13T18:00Z. Notifications sent to @maria and @sheriff-jen. Audit id: promo-20260313-rc1.

maria: :thumbsup: will monitor dashboards and escalate if needed.

sheriff-jen: :ok_hand: on standby.

kevin: Quick note: if we hit a partial degradation (small increase in 95th token latency but no errors) prefer throttling canary traffic back to 5% + additional warm, not an immediate full rollback. Full rollback only for persistent SLO/err breaches.

ash: Noted and added to the post-deploy checklist. Thanks folks — will run the post-promo readout if everything is green.

kevin: Thanks all. Will post final status in this thread after the window.
